steps: Read existing RoundLoop/configs to make a DISTINCT concept
Authored ServerScriptService.PurgeProtocol server script: spawn ring, staggered drops, wave-clear via Humanoid.Died, victory
Disabled the old RoundLoop so only PurgeProtocol drives the playtest log
Verified compile OK and no TestAutoKill/auto-kill symbol present

recipe.text: Purge Protocol is a fresh RoundLoop-family lifecycle: each wave releases enemies in timed SUB-BATCHES ('drops') around a spawn ring rather than all at once. Config-driven via ReplicatedStorage.PurgeConfig (waves list + tuning). Enemies clone from ServerStorage.EnemyTemplate; a wave clears only when every spawned enemy dies via real Humanoid.Died (player-level combat), then the loop advances; after the final wave it sets PurgeState='victory'. All lifecycle events print with the [Purge] tag; NO auto-kill/test hook is wired. Disabled the pre-existing RoundLoop so logs are unambiguous.
